translated_title: Dollar Trades at 16.98 Pesos, a Low Not Seen Since May 2024
original_title: Dólar cotiza en 16.98 pesos, un mínimo que no se veía desde mayo de 2024
author: Alejandro Alegría
meta_description: Mexico's 'super peso' smashes past the 17-peso barrier to 16.98 per dollar, its strongest since May 2024, another embarrassment for the doomsayers who told everyone to buy dollars.
